actions.name: Tag Charts
actions.description: Ports billboard-tag's existing review/apply flow: reviews fuzzy chart matches and merges exact matches in one pass. Never removes a tag.

actions.name: Tag Genres + Subgenres
actions.description: Reviews genre/subgenre candidates gathered from MusicBrainz, Discogs, LLM web search, and the local audio model, each with source attribution and confidence. Merges approved tags; never removes or overwrites existing ones.
